The closest-work comparison separates four method families as project
categories. Finite-index subgroup descriptions and computable Fuchsian domains
provide representation and reduction ingredients (P31-S01--P31-S06). Ambient,
arithmetic, and hyperbolic conjugacy methods provide decision ingredients that
still require an exact \texttt{Gamma\_0(11)} specialization
(P31-S07--P31-S20). The proof-carrying-code record \citep{P31-S23} and
tamper-evident-logging record \citep{P31-S24} are retained as metadata-identified
method neighbors only; no substantive method-pattern transfer is drawn from
them without an exact retained original passage. Aggregate class-counting
neighbors remain post-closure controls (P31-S21--P31-S22). The resolved-domain
canonicalizer specification, total disposition, derived regression audit, and
distinct \texttt{G/I/C} projections are prospective project design choices.
They are not a new conjugacy theorem, an implemented solver, a priority claim,
or an exhaustive novelty claim.

The synthesis does not choose among polygon, arithmetic, or
hyperbolic-group implementations. It instead specifies the acceptance
condition that any route must meet. A route is admissible only if its
hypotheses are proved for the frozen marked object, its output is
canonical under the orientation policy, its primitive-root and inverse
fields are exact, and an independent verifier can replay success and
failure evidence. No retained source has been admitted here as the completed
project serialization or as a proof that this combined contract terminates.
This is a boundary on project use, not a claim that such a method is absent
from the literature.

The method-component matrix has 24 rows: seven of P31-S01--P31-S22
carry bounded exact locators whose retained passages provide bounded context for
the registered uses without proving the registered roles in full, while the other
15 record explicit bounded passage unavailability rather than guessed anchors.
P31-S23 and P31-S24 retain publisher-level locators as metadata pointers only.
The Stage-4.5 Round-2 inputs contain no bound original-source passage text and
excerpt hash supporting their asserted proof-carrying or tamper-evident method
patterns, so those substantive transfers are withheld. Every row states the
component or claim role, passage status, applicable hypothesis or scope, and a
prohibited transfer. None establishes a P31 owner theorem, implementation,
semantic adjudicator, or scientific result. No direct quotation is used.

The synthesis uses source-effect discipline rather than vote counting.
Registered categories distinguish subgroup representation, ambient reduction,
proof-carrying checking, and append-only ledger verification. A category is a
project-assigned role, not evidence that a source passage establishes that role.
P31-S23 and P31-S24 are used only for metadata-level positioning; their proposed
method-pattern transfers remain withheld. Venue recognition and algorithmic
proximity do not erase hypothesis, object, or output-type boundaries. The
method-passage matrix records the bounded uses and forbidden transfers row by
row; missing theorem-to-certificate links remain visible obligations.
